entries.title: Genesis 49:1
segments: And Jacob called to his sons and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in the days to come.

entries.title: Genesis 49:2
segments: Gather yourselves together, and hear, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel your father.

entries.title: Genesis 49:3
segments: Reuben, you [are] my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity and the excellency of power.

entries.title: Genesis 49:4
segments: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father's bed; then you defiled it. He went up to my couch.

entries.title: Genesis 49:5
segments: Simeon and Levi [are] brothers; tools of violence [are] their weapons.

entries.title: Genesis 49:6
segments: Oh my soul, do not come into their secret. Let not my honor be united with their assembly. For in their anger they killed a man, and in their self-will they hamstrung a bull.

entries.title: Genesis 49:7
segments: Let their anger be cursed, for [it was] fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 49:8
segments: Judah, may your brothers praise you. May your hand [be] in the neck of your enemies. May your father's sons bow before you.

entries.title: Genesis 49:9
segments: Judah [is] a lion's whelp. My son, you have gone up from the prey. He stooped, he crouched like a lion; and like a lioness, who shall rouse him?

entries.title: Genesis 49:10
segments: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor a Lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come. And the obedience of the peoples to him.

entries.title: Genesis 49:11
segments: Binding his foal to the vine, and his ass's colt to the choice vine, he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes.

entries.title: Genesis 49:12
segments: His eyes [shall be] sparkling with wine, and his teeth white from milk.

entries.title: Genesis 49:13
segments: Zebulun shall live at the sea shore. And he [shall be] a haven for ships, and his border beside Sidon.

entries.title: Genesis 49:14
segments: Issachar [is] a strong ass crouching down between the sheepfolds.

entries.title: Genesis 49:15
segments: And he saw that rest [was] good and that the land was pleasant. And he bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a tribute-slave.

entries.title: Genesis 49:16
segments: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 49:17
segments: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that bites the horse's heels, so that its rider shall fall backward.

entries.title: Genesis 49:18
segments: I have waited for Your salvation, O LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 49:19
segments: Gad, raiders shall attack him, and he shall attack [their] heel.

entries.title: Genesis 49:20
segments: Out of Asher his bread [shall be] fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

entries.title: Genesis 49:21
segments: Naphtali [is] a deer let loose. He gives goodly words.

entries.title: Genesis 49:22
segments: Joseph [is] a fruitful son, a fruitful son by a well, whose branches run over the wall.

entries.title: Genesis 49:23
segments: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot [at him], and an archer lurks for him.

entries.title: Genesis 49:24
segments: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob (from the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel);

entries.title: Genesis 49:25
segments: by the God of your father, who shall help you. And may the Almighty bless you with blessings of Heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies beneath, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.

entries.title: Genesis 49:26
segments: The blessings of your father are above the blessings of my ancestors, to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. They shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him, the ruler, the leader of his brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 49:27
segments: Benjamin is a wolf that tears in pieces. In the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

entries.title: Genesis 49:28
segments: All these [were] the twelve tribes of Israel. And this [is] what their father spoke to them, and blessed them; everyone according to his blessing he blessed them.

entries.title: Genesis 49:29
segments: And he charged them and said to them, I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

entries.title: Genesis 49:30
segments: in the cave that [is] in the field of Machpelah, which [is] before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, the field which Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite for a burying-place.

entries.title: Genesis 49:31
segments: They buried Abraham and his wife Sarah there, and they buried Isaac and his wife Rebekah. And I buried Leah there;

entries.title: Genesis 49:32
segments: the purchase of the field and the cave in it, from the sons of Heth.

entries.title: Genesis 49:33
segments: And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered his feet into the bed. And he expired, and was gathered to his people.
